title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the budget of the European Union Agencies for the financial year 2023
part_text: 110. Highlights that geographical balance is still a challenge for several agencies for which considerable percentages of their overall staff are nationals of the Member State where the agencies are located; considers that this balance should not, however, be pursued blindly at the expense of the quality of applications, which must remain the primary criterion in the staff selection procedure;
